dataset_title: Recorded offences by local government area
native_record_key: Table 01 year + year-ending month + LGA name
record_granularity: LGA rolling-year offence count and rate at quarterly release
completeness_rule: Select latest by-LGA XLSX resource from DataVic catalog, validate Table 01 headers and parse every row. Do not use suburb-level data or claim an individual incident location.

admission_evidence.native_record_key: Table 01 year + year-ending month + LGA name
admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Table 01 header and all rows validated against selected resource

notes: DataVic states CC BY 4.0 and quarterly release. Table 01 contains rolling 12-month LGA statistics, not a single-quarter count or live crime incidents. Current XLSX has LGA names but no LGA codes; T058 must join an official boundary vintage before publishing area indicators.
